subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be controlled by the existing `replyToMode` model or by a new separate `dmThreadMode` account setting?
rationale: This is a user-facing config/API choice that changes a previously fixed DM delivery failure mode, and repository policy treats new config surfaces and message-delivery behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use the existing reply policy
options.body: Treat DM threading as part of the existing Google Chat reply/threading model and ask the branch to extend that surface rather than adding a parallel DM-only key.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode`
options.body: Allow the new setting, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs/help, upgrade semantics, and real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind broader thread work
options.body: Wait for the related Google Chat thread-routing and session-thread PRs to settle so this does not add a competing config surface.

recommendation.title: Use the existing reply policy
recommendation.body: Treat DM threading as part of the existing Google Chat reply/threading model and ask the branch to extend that surface rather than adding a parallel DM-only key.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and verified the prior DM thread-suppression follow-up and has recent history on the Google Chat thread-reply path.
